def format_shipping_address(data):
    name = data.get('shipping_name', '') or ''
    street = data.get('shipping_street', '') or ''
    city = data.get('shipping_city', '') or ''
    postcode = data.get('shipping_postcode', '') or ''
    line3 = "{} {}".format(city, postcode).strip()
    return "\n".join([str(name), str(street), line3])
fix_rationale: Removed the unused billing_line that referenced billing fields. Also normalized field values to safe strings to prevent type errors and ensure only the shipping fields appear in the output.
